title: A2A (Agent2Agent protocol): how agents hand tasks to other agents, and where you can stop them
summary: Hold: the page treats Power Platform data-policy coverage as an open question even though Microsoft documents policies covering Copilot Studio agents and custom connectors. The package-blocking command exists, but the documentation checked does not establish that it blocks an agent registered only through an A2A agent card.
